summary: lu-pinto 提交 EIP-8037 修改，指出 EIP-7702 授权按最坏情况预扣的 gas 在纠正后只能进入状态 gas 池或退款，不能再用于计算，分配并不高效。EIP-8037 中 CALLCODE 不能创建账户的澄清合并。anshalshukla 提交后量子 attestation 聚合者 EIP。ethresear.ch 讨论 ePBS 内置支付通道对中继的影响，以及 EIP-8188 带来的冷热存储分离。当晚 ACDT #82 决定 EIP-7997 改用 Arachnid 工厂。

items.topic: EIP-8037 下 EIP-7702 授权的 gas 计算
items.title: EIP-8037：EIP-7702 超额扣费的不公平分配
items.note: （lu-pinto）提交。在 EIP-8037 中，处理 7702 授权前先按最坏情况扣费，用户必须预留远多于实际需要的 gas，这可防止计算型 griefing 攻击；但这部分超额在处理委托时被纠正后，只计入状态 gas 池或退款计数，不能再用于计算。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: unfair allocation of EIP-7702 overcharges
items.note_en: (lu-pinto), submitted. In EIP-8037, worst cases are charged for 7702 authorization processing before the authorizations are processed, so users must commit much more gas than they need; this prevents compute griefing. But when the overcharge is corrected during delegation processing, it goes to the state gas pool or the refund counter and can no longer be used for compute.

items.topic: EIP-8037 下 EIP-7702 授权的 gas 计算
items.title: EIP-8037：账户创建情形中移除 CALLCODE
items.note: （rjl493456442）合并。CALLCODE 在调用者自己的账户上下文中执行，只会把 value 转给调用者自己，不可能创建账户。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: remove CALLCODE from the account creation cases
items.note_en: (rjl493456442), merged. CALLCODE runs in the caller's own account context and only transfers value to the caller itself, so it cannot create an account.

items.topic: 后量子共识与区块构建
items.title: 新 EIP：后量子 attestation 聚合者
items.note: （anshalshukla）提交，描述聚合者如何收集验证者签名的 attestation，并把其中的后量子签名证明成简洁的聚合证明。
items.note_en: (anshalshukla), submitted, describing how aggregators collect signed validator attestations and prove the attached post-quantum signatures into succinct aggregate proofs.

items.topic: 后量子共识与区块构建
items.title: ethresear.ch：无需信任的支付与中继
items.note: 22:01（jcschlegel）。ePBS 在协议内加入默认密封的第一价格 builder 到 proposer 支付通道；作者预计中继会继续存在，但能提供的服务会改变，协议内无需信任支付可能固化第一价格区块拍卖，并推动拍卖走向密封出价。
items.note_en: 22:01 (jcschlegel). ePBS adds an in-protocol, sealed-by-default first-price channel for builder to proposer payments; the authors expect relays to survive but with a different offering, and predict that trustless in-protocol payments will ossify a first-price block auction and push it toward sealed bids.

items.topic: 后量子共识与区块构建
items.title: ethresear.ch：冷热存储分离实践
items.note: 11:19（weiihann）。EIP-8188 为每个账户和存储槽加入共识可见的最后修改时间，让所有客户端对哪些状态是热、哪些是冷有同一信号，EIP 本身不规定存储架构。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Hot-Cold Storage Separation in Practice
items.note_en: 11:19 (weiihann). EIP-8188 adds a consensus-visible last-modified timestamp to every account and storage slot, giving all clients the same signal about which state is hot and which is cold; the EIP itself mandates no storage architecture.

items.title_en: Eli Ben-Sasson: different flavors of privacy enable different features and use cases

summary_en: lu-pinto submitted an EIP-8037 change pointing out that the worst-case gas precharged for EIP-7702 authorizations, once corrected, only goes to the state gas pool or the refund counter and can no longer be used for compute, which is not an efficient allocation. A clarification that CALLCODE cannot create accounts in EIP-8037 was merged. anshalshukla submitted an EIP for post-quantum attestation aggregators. ethresear.ch discussed how the in-protocol ePBS payment channel affects relays, and the hot-cold storage separation enabled by EIP-8188. In the evening ACDT #82 switched EIP-7997 to the Arachnid factory.
